{{Quote|That open pit leads to the realm of spirits. Only the greatest wizards have returned!|[[Zarrak]]|<ref name="The First Apprentice">{{Ewoks|The First Apprentice}}</ref>}}
The '''Realm of Spirits''' was a location within [[Zarrak's mountain]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]]. According to the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Zarrak]], only the greatest wizards were able to enter and return from its depths. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Zarrak attempted to plunge the Ewok [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] into the Realm of Spirits, but he was stopped by the Ewok [[Shaman/Legends|Shaman]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]]. During a fight with the Ewoks, Zarrak was attacked by flying leaves, [[Telekinesis/Legends|manipulated]] by Teebo, causing him to run from the attack and fall headfirst into the Realm of Spirits.
